values.note: 151 wooded sites in an East and a North area plus a group site (mass.gov rounds to 150). 141 are RV-capable: 57 pull-throughs, and 128 sites take 24 ft or more (70 at 28 ft, 38 at 38 ft, two at 40 ft).

note: On USACE land (Birch Hill flood-control project); the campground is run by MA DCR through Otter River State Forest staff, so credited state. Wooded sites on and near an 85-acre lake, next to 50 miles of trails in the Birch Hill Wildlife Management Area. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica + mass.gov: DCR operates it on Army Corps land ('The DCR, via Otter River State Forest staff, manages 4,221 acres of Army Corps land'); $17/$54 (2026 table) and 2026 season 5/14-10/11 unchanged; 151 sites, no hookups, flush toilets/showers/dump, 57 pull-throughs, added max_rig_ft 40 (per-site; 128 sites 24 ft+), reservations required, 14-day cumulative limit. Note cleaned of field facts.
